text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on April 30, 2020. Mayor Tory, during the morning session of the meeting, thanked Members of Council for gathering to take part in the first virtual meeting of City Council. Mayor Tory also thanked the City Clerk, the Deputy City Clerk and their team for helping Councillors get ready for the virtual meeting. Mayor Tory noted that he is committed to having regular meetings to deal with urgent business as Council is doing today. Mayor Tory advised that it has been over a month since declaring a state of emergency in City of Toronto and that the decision was made on the advice of the Medical Officer of Health which was for as many people as possible to stay home, for people to keep their distance from one another, to protect the vulnerable and to keep from overwhelming our health care system.
